summary: Rivet là orchestrator nhanh và scalable cho các workloads agentic, giúp quản lý và phối hợp các tác vụ phức tạp cho agent trong môi trường cloud và serverless.
usecases: Orchestrate multiple AI agents to collaborate on complex tasks such as research or code generation.
Manage stateful agent workflows in serverless environments using durable objects and FoundationDB.
Scale actor-based systems for real-time multiplayer or collaborative applications.
ideas: Combine with FoundationDB for persistent agent memory across restarts and restarts.
Use as a backend for AI-powered collaborative editors where each user session runs as an agent.
Integrate with Cloudflare Workers for edge-deployed, low-latency agent orchestration.
